key.name: calendar-uid
key.description: The UID of the Evolution Data Server calendar source to show events from. Use 'ALL' to show events from all calendars.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Where to place the indicator in the top panel, anchored to real panel elements rather than a raw index.

key.name: max-title-length
key.description: Maximum number of characters for the event title before truncating.

key.name: refresh-interval-seconds
key.description: How often to check for upcoming events, in seconds.

key.name: time-display
key.description: Show the absolute time ('absolute'), a relative countdown ('relative'), or the countdown only once the event is near and the absolute time otherwise ('smart').

key.name: text-hierarchy
key.description: Show the time in bold with a dimmed title. When false, time and title are rendered as one flat string separated by a middle dot.

key.name: accent-time
key.description: Tint the time with the system accent colour once the event is near.

key.name: tonal-surface
key.description: Draw a faint accent-tinted surface behind the indicator once the event is imminent.

key.name: emphasis-mode
key.description: Scale the emphasis as the event approaches ('urgency'), or apply the near-event emphasis constantly ('always').

key.name: soon-minutes
key.description: Minutes before the event at which it counts as 'soon': the time switches to a relative countdown and, if enabled, takes the accent colour.

key.name: imminent-minutes
key.description: Minutes before the event at which it counts as 'imminent': the tonal surface appears, if enabled.

key.name: show-ongoing
key.description: While an event is in progress, keep showing it (marked as ongoing) instead of moving on to the next one.
